entities.description: A map of Ireland, showing the island's outline with a light beige landmass against a pale blue background. The map includes the distinct shapes of the western coastline, the northern border with Northern Ireland, and the eastern coast along the Irish Sea.

A map of the United Kingdom, showing the outlines of Great Britain and Northern Ireland against a light blue background. The landmass is depicted in a pale beige color with no internal details or labels.

A stylized, irregularly shaped landmass in a pale cream color with a rough, torn-paper texture, set against a solid light blue background. The landmass features jagged edges and faint, vertical brownish lines on its surface suggesting terrain or texture.

A top-down view of a map showing the continent of Europe and parts of North Africa and the Middle East, with landmasses in a light beige color and water bodies in a pale blue. The map includes detailed coastlines, country borders, and geographical features such as the Scandinavian Peninsula, the British Isles, the Iberian Peninsula, and the Italian Peninsula.

A map of the Scandinavian Peninsula, featuring Norway, Sweden, and Finland, with a light blue background representing the sea. The landmass is depicted in a pale beige color with thin, light brown lines indicating borders and possibly rivers or roads. The coastline is detailed, showing the intricate fjords and islands along the western coast of Norway and the eastern coast of Sweden. The Baltic Sea is visible to the east, with the Gulf of Bothnia separating Sweden and Finland. The map includes parts of the Baltic states and the northern coast of Russia to the northeast.

A pale beige landmass with a jagged, irregular coastline borders a light blue body of water at the top. Thin, faint lines traverse the land, suggesting internal boundaries or roads, while the water features a smooth, uniform color.

attributes.internal_lines: thin, faint, possibly roads or boundaries
